summary: Inline contextual message with a tone (info, success, warning, error), title, actions and optional dismissal.
whenToUse: Warnings related to a section of the page.

props.name: actions
props.description: Buttons or links after the message.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Shows the close button; visibility is up to you.

props.name: icon
props.description: Replaces or hides (null) the tone icon.

props.name: live
props.description: status/alert role for messages that appear dynamically.

keyboard.action: Reaches the actions and the close button.

accessibility: The tone is conveyed through localized hidden text (“Error:”), icon and color.
Use live only for messages inserted after page load; don't overuse assertive.
responsive: Text and actions wrap; no fixed width.
customization: className/style; colors come from color.feedback.* tokens.
commonMistakes: Setting live on messages present at load: they are announced needlessly or ignored.

examples.name: ContentVariants
examples.title: No title, icons and long text
examples.description: Text-only Alert, custom or no icon, and a long message in English.

examples.name: ErrorSummary
examples.title: Form error summary
examples.description: On submit, an assertive Alert lists the errors; each field shows its own message. Submission is simulated locally.
